operations.command: set -e; nixosctl immutability plan > /tmp/immutability-plan; grep -F 'volume @root /' /tmp/immutability-plan; grep -F 'keep dir /etc/nixos -> @persist/dirs/etc!nixos' /tmp/immutability-plan; grep -F 'next /run/immutability-top' /tmp/immutability-plan; printf planned

set -e; printf prepared-transient > /root/e2e-prepared-transient; nixosctl immutability prepare; test -e /root/e2e-prepared-transient; dev=$(findmnt -no SOURCE / | sed 's/\[.*//'); top=/run/e2e-prepared-top; mkdir -p "$top"; mount -t btrfs -o subvolid=5 "$dev" "$top"; btrfs subvolume show "$top/@snapshots/@root/NEXT" >/dev/null; test ! -e "$top/@snapshots/@root/NEXT/root/e2e-prepared-transient"; ls "$top/@snapshots/.immutability/logs"/immutability-*.log >/dev/null; umount "$top"; printf prepared

set -e; host=/etc/nixos/nix/hosts/{{arch}}/VM-TEST/VM-TEST.nix; sed -i 's/\.mode = "[^"]*"/.mode = "publish-prepared"/g' "$host"; nixos-rebuild boot --flake /etc/nixos#VM-TEST-Standard-Boot; printf publish-prepared-configured

set -e; test ! -e /root/e2e-prepared-transient; test -d /etc/nixos/.git; dev=$(findmnt -no SOURCE / | sed 's/\[.*//'); top=/run/e2e-published-top; mkdir -p "$top"; mount -t btrfs -o subvolid=5 "$dev" "$top"; test ! -e "$top/@snapshots/@root/NEXT"; grep -R 'Publishing prepared NEXT for @root' "$top/@snapshots/.immutability/logs"; umount "$top"; printf published
